title: Expose the box queue wrapper to VIXEN worktrees
body: This lane had no local tools/with-test-lock.sh, so every build and test invoked /home/liory/projects/undertow/tools/with-test-lock.sh by absolute path. Provide a discoverable configured queue entry point for standalone VIXEN worktrees.

title: Make the CodeGraph query route available in isolated VIXEN worktrees
body: The required codegraph explore step could not use this fresh worktree because it had no .codegraph index or configured read-only query route. Provide a safe, documented query or index bootstrap for disposable worktrees.

title: Keep FetchContent in the active VIXEN worktree by default
body: Configure and every build needed VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE=<worktree>/build/cornellcap-fetchcontent-cache; without it CMake selected the shared user cache. Default to the active worktree cache so reconfigure and builds do not mutate shared content.

title: Make VIXEN presets discoverable from the repository root
body: Running cmake --preset vixen-wsl from the worktree root failed because CMakePresets.json is under VIXEN; changing into VIXEN made the same command work. Add a root forwarding preset or document and validate the required working directory.

title: Avoid parallel app asset staging collisions
body: A build containing VIXEN and vixen_editor raced while both post-build steps copied into build/wsl/binaries/assets; rebuilding vixen_editor separately succeeded. Use target-specific staging or serialize the shared copy step.

title: Label CTest cases by owning suite
body: The documented numeric CTest range selected SVO and application NOT_BUILT placeholders and omitted the first 450 RenderGraph cases. I had to parse ctest --show-only=json-v1 executable paths and run positions 43-1355 plus 1357-1358. Add stable suite labels or a RenderGraph-only selector.

title: Run windowed capture producers as CTest fixtures
body: HudRenderCapture only reads preexisting hud_capture PNGs from VIXEN_HUD_CAPTURE_DIR, so the suite needed an absolute populated directory and current outputs from a separate runner. Attach the HUD capture producer as a fixture and pass its output directory to the file assertions.

title: Derive render-target usage from graph consumers
body: The main offscreen RenderTarget needed VK_IMAGE_USAGE_STORAGE_BIT added manually because downstream descriptor stages bind it as storage. Derive compatible image usage from the declared graph consumers instead of maintaining this mask in graph setup.

title: Honor optional slots in InputNode validation
body: InputNodeConfig::WINDOW is optional for headless graphs, but ValidateInput still threw when it was unconnected. I changed InputNode to GetOptionalInput so the production graph could run headless. Make validation follow optional-slot metadata.

title: Represent WSI synchronization capability in the target contract
body: The offscreen path has target image indices but no acquire or present semaphores. I had to thread usesOffscreenTarget and hasWsiSemaphores through SdiStageCommon and add empty-array guards in ComputeStageNode, ComputeDispatchNode, and BlitNode. Declare target synchronization capabilities once so wiring and execution derive them.
